configure_ax_sweeper: configure the AxSweeperConf dataclass to set up Hydra Ax sweeper with max batch size and ax config
configure_early_stopping: configure the EarlyStopConfig dataclass to set max epochs without improvement and epsilon threshold
configure_experiment: configure the ExperimentConfig dataclass to set objective name, minimize flag, and parameter constraints
configure_ax_client: configure the ClientConfig dataclass to enable verbose logging and set a random seed for reproducibility
configure_ax_config: configure the AxConfig dataclass to set max trials, early stop, experiment, and noisy measurement settings
